flags.message: JBD total 455h runs hot against the takeoff: drywall 65h for 30 sheets (2.2 h/sheet incl. finish, ~35-40h is defensible), floor system 87h for 430 sf incl. 25h soffit, and wall framing 28h @0.45 h/LF for 63 LF are each 20-40% above card-rate arithmetic even after the canon +20-25% elevated premium; treat the JBD as a ceiling, not a target.

JBD double-counts WRB labor (6h sheathing+WRB line plus a separate 3h WRB line) and prices the 3 dump runs in both Material and Equipment ($2,700 for a 3-run scope); deduct the 3h and one $1,350 when cross-checking.

Post count: proposal specifies (8) posts/footers while the presentation First Floor Plan (p3) draws 7 at ~7'-2" spacing; canon says the proposal governs and the presentation is visualization-only, so takeoff carries 8, but the field footer layout must be confirmed before pockets are cut (±1 footer ≈ 1-2h, low sizing impact).

Presentation set (dated 5-26-26, after the Apr 9 signing) shows scope beyond the contract: 7 windows incl. two 5050s, a 6568 double door on the house wall, a railed deck with exterior stairs, gable/hip roof forms, brick post wraps, and Option 2-level interior finish; per canon the signed proposal governs and none of this is adopted, but if the customer expects the drawn version the plan changes materially (deck, stairs, extra openings) — PM should confirm the customer understands what the $66,200 buys.

JBD assumes 8 ft walls and derives 504 sf sheathing/insulation and 848 sf drywall from it, but no source states ceiling height; because the EXISTING shed roof is being reseated, new plate height is dictated by the existing bearing line — every 8-ft-based area is provisional until field-measured.

'Cut concrete footers near existing pad' may require saw-cutting the existing slab under the sunroom at up to 8 locations; neither document prices a saw or cutting hours, so groundwork could gain ~1.5h per pocket if the pad is in the way.

Permits and inspections are contracted-in by the proposal but carry zero hours in the JBD; this job has electrical + mechanical rough, so expect footing, framing, electrical rough, mechanical, insulation and final visits (~6 × 2h per card) rather than the 4h no-MEP bundle.

Drywall is over brick on the 43 ft house-side wall (p4 callout) — furring/strapping and any insulation strategy for that masonry wall are not priced or described anywhere, yet the JBD counts 344 sf of drywall on it; add furring hours to the drywall basis or confirm direct-adhered.

general_conditions is split across main_demolition and structural_framing because shoring must stand from before demo until the roof is reseated on new walls; PM 8h in that section is overhead and should not inflate either component's crew-hours.

The JBD floor_system section carries 25h of vinyl soffit under the floor; it is mapped to cladding_roof (exterior, overhead from scaffold) rather than structural_framing so interior-concurrency limits and elevated premiums apply correctly.
